en: The image depicts a vintage scene of a group of people, dressed in early 20th-century European attire, sitting and standing around a motorbus. The backdrop consists of a building with prominent German-language signs including 'Weltreisebureau Union' and 'PASSAGE Eingang.' The men and women are well-dressed, with hats characteristic of the period. There is a mix of formality and casualness among the passengers and staff, suggesting an organized outing or tour.
